*   **Decomposition Level Limits:** The number of decomposition levels is constrained by the image size and the Group of Slices (GOS) size.
It is not always possible to decompose to deeper levels.
*   **Unbalanced Decomposition:** The asymmetric tree structure naturally supports unbalanced decomposition, allowing more levels in the transaxial domain than in the axial domain.
*   **Complexity:** The time complexity is dominated by the SPIHT encoding process, which is linear with respect to the number of coefficients.
It addresses the limitations of symmetric 3-D SPIHT by introducing an asymmetric tree structure that links coefficients differently across axial sub-bands.
